solutionName: Multi Cloud Attack Coverage Essentials - Resource Abuse

decisions.summary: ARM candidate deployment xdrq-pr-template-e27f8c7a896aaaf2 and batch acceptance deployment xdrq-pr-batch-255bcfe9d1b33ab7 succeeded in OptimizeSentinelResourceGroup and all 9 Sentinel Analytic Rules and 9 Defender XDR Custom Detections were deployed disabled and verified via GET readback.
decisions.rationale: Verified full V3.1 package deployment (3.2.2) and independent readback of all 9 Analytic Rules and 9 XDR Custom Detections.

decisions.summary: Ingested 22 realistic multi-cloud mock records across AWSCloudTrail, CloudAppEvents, SigninLogs, and GCPAuditLogs into the locked lab workspace and verified 9/9 exact-query non-zero row parity (2/2 per rule) across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed live dual-surface KQL execution and strict row-level parity across all 9 migrated detections.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: Live scheduled alert firing in the shared lab workspace is waived to keep all rules disabled in Defender XDR and Sentinel. All 9 Analytic Rules and 9 XDR Custom Detections were deployed disabled via ARM and Graph/ARM PUT, verified disabled via GET readback and portal UI traversal (Evidence/receipts/graph-detection-deployment.json, Evidence/receipts/arm-deployment-readback.json), and 9/9 exact-query row parity with non-zero rows (2/2 per rule across AWSCloudTrail, CloudAppEvents, SigninLogs, GCPAuditLogs) was verified live across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting after DCR ingestion of 22 mock records (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: 7-dimension fired-alert parity depends on live scheduled alert generation (E2E-Q02). Query-level row parity across all 9 Analytic Rule / XDR Custom Detection pairs is verified 9/9 with matching non-zero row counts (2/2 per rule) and output columns across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: Controlled alert parity state machine completion (complete-alert-parity) is waived alongside E2E-Q02/E2E-Q03 because scheduled alert firing was not triggered in the shared lab; all 9 Analytic Rules and 9 Custom Detections are verified disabled (enabled:false / isEnabled:false) in Evidence/receipts/graph-detection-deployment.json and 9/9 live non-zero query row parity is verified in Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: Multi Cloud Attack Coverage Essentials - Resource Abuse contains 9 Analytic Rules / 9 XDR Detections and 0 Workbooks (Workbooks/ is empty). All 9/9 detection queries passed live runtime validation on both Sentinel Log Analytics (Detections SDK True) and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (AH True) with HTTP 200 and non-zero row parity (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json); the workbook query sub-condition (0/0 workbooks) is N/A for this detection-only solution.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: E2E-V04 is the rollup check requiring all qualification-evidence.json sections to be PASS. Deployment (9/9 ARs + 9/9 CDs + ARM readback), imageRendering, mockIngestion (22 rows across AWSCloudTrail/CloudAppEvents/SigninLogs/GCPAuditLogs), uiTraversal (11/11 portal pages), urlVerification, and dualSurfaceKql (9/9 detection pairs with non-zero LA/AH row parity) all PASS; alertLifecycle and alertParity are waived under E2E-Q02/E2E-Q03/TK-Q11.
